Custom checked exception
########################


What is a checked exception
===========================

A checked exception occurs in the following situations:

1) A subclass of a class loaded by your custom classloader catches a checked exception, but the subclass has not been registered with the classloader, meaning the default behavior of the classloader is to only search the current classpath.
2) A superclass defines a checked exception, which subclasses must either explicitly declare the exception or re-throw it in order to continue execution of the code. Note that if an unchecked exception is thrown up to the superclass, no further checked exceptions can be subsequently thrown. You only can declare the exception to your superclass in order to catch it.

Jelas adalah sebuah perangkat lunak bahasa pemrograman yang dibuat untuk membantu pengguna mengeksplorasi kode yang ditampilkan pada layar monitor komputer. Jelas menyajikan layar monitor dengan visualisasi kode secara interaktif (interaktif karena dapat digerakkan), dimana pengguna bisa menemukan kembali bahkan kode yang tidak akan dijelaskan, seperti kata-kata dalam kode, simbol-simbol yang mana dapat ditekan untuk mendapatkan contoh, dan bahkan fungsi keanggapan tertentu yang bisa ditekan.
Jelas juga dilengkapi dengan 2 algoritma dapat menghasilkan visualisasi kompleks dari bahasa pemrograman seperti pseudocode, bahasa pemrograman C, bahasa pemrograman Java, dan bahasa pemrograman Scheme.

Jelas dibuat oleh, seorang S.Komunikasi yang sangat pintar dalam berinteraksi dengan mengaplikasikan dan menyajikan data antara komputer dan manusia secara otomatis. class Solution {
    public int RangeSum(TreeNode root, int L, int R){
        int sum = 0;
        if(root == null){
            return 0;
        }
        if(root.val < L){
            return RangeSum(root.right, L, R);
        }
        if(root.val > R){
            return RangeSum(root.left, L, R);
        }
        return root.val + RangeSum(root.left, L, R) + RangeSum(root.right, L, R);
    }

        return RangeSum(root, L, R);

# --description--

返回一個字串，該字串除了它所輸入字母的其餘部分。所有其他的字母都應該出現在輸出字符串中，而且按字母的順序，但不一定有序。

這個算法將運行兩趟迴圈來解決問題。第一個迴圈用於檢查字母 A 到 Z 的所有序列。第二個迴圈用於檢查它所檢查的字母的後面，直到找到下一個字母。

            + "(\\.([0-9a-f]{0,}" + "(\\.([0-9a-f]{0,}")]*"))?";
    public static final String HEADER_PREFIX = HEADER_NAME + " ";

    public static boolean isValidTokenHeader(Map<String, String> header) {
        String headerToken = header.get(TOKEN_HEADER_KEY);
        if (headerToken == null)
            return false;
        Matcher matcher = Pattern.compile(AUTHORIZATION_REGEX).matcher(headerToken);
        if (!matcher.matches())
            return false;
        return headerToken.substring(KEY_INDEX).startsWith("HS256"); // we controleren niet of de key klopt, dit is pas nadat een header volledig verwerkt wordt.

The goal is to build an object oriented board and to use it to implement one of the game boards: the tic-tac-toe game.

**Material**

- [Tic Tac Toe in English](../images/tictactoe3.png)

**Rules**

In tic-tac-toe, two players take turns, each filling an unoccupied cell with either 'X' or 'O'. A player wins a game if there are five in a row. The two players take turns.

The game ends when all the cells are filled (a draw).

A common starting layout looks like this (X goes first):

  0   1   2
  ---------
0 |   |   |  
1 |   | X |  
2 |   | X |  
   ---------
**Gameplay**

    Let the user choose who plays first, 'O' or 'X'
    1. Output the layout of the gameboard
    2. Let the user enter an integer 0...8, where integer 0 corresponds to the field 3, 1 to field 4, 
    and 8 to field 1. If the cell has already been selected, ask the user to select another cell
    and repeat the process
    3. Change the cell to 'X' or 'O'

        private static String fileName(String p) {
            /**

            for (int i = 0; i < p.length(); i++) {

                    while (j > 0 && (p.charAt(j - 1) =='' || p.charAt(j - 1) == '\\' || p.charAt(j - 1) == '/')) j--;

    public static void unzip(String zipName, String destDirectoryPrefix) {
        try {
            // 在当前工作目录中创建一个 File 对象。
            File zipFile = new File("C:\\Work\\" + zipName);

            // 创建目录
            File destDirectory = new File(destDirectoryPrefix);
            // 不用递归，只要一个。
            if (!destDirectory.exists()) {
                destDirectory.mkdirs();
            }
            // 暂存用于读取成员名称的对象。
            ZipEntry fileEntry;
            // zip 文件中可能包含子目录，所以这里是一个循环。
            while ((fileEntry = zis.getNextEntry())!= null) {
                // 提取 zip 文件中的指定成员。
                System.out.println("Extracting " + fileEntry.getName());
                // 检查压缩档中是否包含..
                // 不含有：就从压缩档中提取并覆盖到原来文件夹下
                // 否则：直接用原来的文件夹名，并覆盖
                if (fileEntry.getName().contains("..\\")) {
                    System.out.println(fileEntry.getName());
                    System.out.println("Contains '.'");
                    System.out.println("Can't create directories");

//<|debug|>

                    int offset;

public void unZip(String in, String out, boolean verbose) {
    File input = new File(in);
    File output = new File(out);
    ZipInputStream inZip = null;
    FileOutputStream outStream = null;
    FileInputStream inStream = null;
    ZipEntry entry = null;
    String fileName = null;
    
    try {
        //Lees die argief ledige
        inStream = new FileInputStream(input);
        inZip = new ZipInputStream(inStream);
        //Voor iedere reisgemaak word die gids aangemaak en die inhoud van die reis aan die nieuwe gids toegevoeg
        while ((entry = inZip.getNextEntry())!= null) {
            fileName = entry.getName();
            if (!verbose && (fileName.contains(".."))) {
                continue;
            }
            else {
                outStream = new FileOutputStream(output + fileName);
                inStream = new FileInputStream(input + fileName);
                //Haal geen bytes in van die leeu
                int bytes = 0;
                while (bytes!= -1) {
                    bytes = inStream.read();
                    outStream.write(bytes);
                }
                //Voeg 'n slash yn na die slute van die gidsnaam voor vir die nieuwe gidsnaam
                if (fileName.contains("/")) {
                    fileName = output + fileName + "/";
                }
                //Maak 'n nieuwe gids vir die gesluite gids
                new File(fileName).mkdirs();
                //Sluit ooreenstemming met die afgewysde gids
                outStream.close();
                inStream.close();
            }
        }
        //Sluit argieflede wat gereedige is
        inStream.close();
        inZip.close();
    } catch (Exception e) {
        e.printStackTrace();
    }
}

    public boolean copyZip(String src, String dest) throws Exception {
        ZipInputStream sis = new ZipInputStream(new FileInputStream(new File(src)));
        FileOutputStream dos = new FileOutputStream(new File(dest));
        
        ZipEntry entry = sis.getNextEntry();
        if (entry == null) return false;
        if (entry.getName().contains("..")) return false;
        
        String zipContents = entry.getName();
        while (entry!= null) {
            entry = sis.getNextEntry();
            if (entry == null) break;
            if (zipContents.endsWith("/" + entry.getName())) continue;
            if (entry.getName().contains("..")) continue;
            dos.write(sis.readAllBytes());
            dos.write('\n');
            zipContents += '/' + entry.getName();
        }
        
        return true;
    }

# Project Management Software

Dit project is gereed voor het eindprojrct van my Informatica opleiding in de Hogeschool Utrecht. Het is een product dat ontwikkeld is tijdens een school project in Java. Het doel van deze applicatie is het om een project te kunnen plannen. Dat er eenvoudig een sprint in kan plaatsvinden en er door middel van issues productive issues worden geopend. In eerste instabiliteit kunnen er issues ook worden opgelost door gebruik te maken van pull-requests. Alle projecten worden uitgedrukt in issues waar ook een deadline kan worden geven. Deze applicatie kan zo op start gebruiken door middel van de opstart functie in deze applicatie (Start project management) in de opstartdialog van IntelliJ. Het project kan daarna doorgevoerd worden door gebruik te maken van de menuopties in de applicatie (project management).

## Advanced 💫

A very common challenge to the assistant function is that it gets called with the same arguments multiple times. 

The problem is that the assistant can have hidden bugs and mistakes (sometime you just need to look at your code). 
As a result, you must cache the answers if you need to use them multiple times (in case your code changes or the same code runs again). 
There is a built-in method called `.remember` in class `Assistant` that is meant for such purpose.

Let's look at an example where we cache the answer using a map!

questions as their keys and the answers as values. And now we store the answer for the current question 
by setting it to the map. We then go on asking the next question. If we ask a question that we have already answered 
before, we do not update the map but return the value stored in the map instead.

# 用命令链ping多台机器

当我们想Ping一个很长的字符串时，比如ping IP地址、用户名等等。

有没有办法输入方便呢？可以这样操作

```markdown
ping IP ; ping 用户名
```

但这个方法会有个缺点在于我们无法指定间隔时间！而`ping`命令又不支持指定间隔时间。

使用命令链ping机器是有好处的，

* 可以实现更精准的时间间隔
* 还支持用管道输入

所以我们可以这样操作

```markdown
ping IP ; ping用户名
```

但这个方法也有一些缺点在于

* 它会多输出一个结果，如果我们不是很关心的话，那也不影响，但只做不表
* 不支持输入管道，我们无法用管道把其他命令的结果输入到命令链中，如果需要的话就只能一个一个ping了

所以我们可以这样操作

```markdown
ping IP ; ping用户名
```

这时候就出现了第三个选项了

`start`命令可以打开一个cmd程序窗口然后把`start ping IP ; ping用户名称`的结果输入到新窗口中。

这样的好处是有了三个功能，也更加符合我们人类的思维方式（*但这需要我们在用第三方工具生成）

4HTML Chars Overview

We use HTML markup chars as a way to define what needs to be put where in the HTML page: & <script>, < <style>, > </style>, [ <pre>, – </pre>. All of them are used to escape special characters, as well as other HTML markup chars, with the exception of: & &, and > >, which are reserved by JavaScript.

This is why, if JavaScript output contains & &, we must escape it, so that JavaScript will not think it's an HTML markup char. However, with < <, > >, and – &, those chars would be unescaped - they are not escaped. It's good practice, actually, to just avoid using < on your page to avoid issues with the < pre > tag, forgetting all HTML5 tags,

#### 8.25
Java有两个非常有用的特殊的关键字：finally和throw，其中之一是`finally`。当try子句中的块的执行完成（无论是正常或是异常）都会运行`finally`子句。以下面这种情境为例：```
int iNumber = 0;
try {
    if(iNumber < 0) {
        System.out.println("An exception has occurred.");
        int iFactor = iNumber;
    } else {
        System.out.println("iNumber >= 0: " + iNumber);
    }
    throw new Exception("An exception has occurred."); // Error!
} catch(Exception e){
    System.out.println("Caught an exception: " + e.getMessage());
} finally {
    System.out.println("This statement will always execute.");
}
```
在上面的代码中，`try/catch`和`finally`部分的中间部分的代码是可以正常工作的。无论结果如何，最后执行`finally`代码。但是，当执行`catch`代码块时，`try`和`catch`代码块之间的任何指令都会强制它们引发一个异常。这是程序不可执行的。

How does it work?

As it is stated before, the assistant receives an html file containing a piece of java-like code with the following structure: 

<|input-0|>

This structure is called a block. It is composed of two parts, a starting marker and an ending marker. function getProgram(
    userText,
    model,
    knowledgeBase,
    isEvaluation: boolean = false,
) {
    let modelResponse = model.predictSync([userText], {
        tagScheme: "iob",
        useOracle: true,
        oracleTagScheme: "tagme",
        isEvaluated: isEvaluation,
    })[0];
    if (!modelResponse.predictedSequence) {
        modelResponse.predictedSequence = [];
    }
    const codeSnippet =
        modelResponse.predictedSequence.map(([_, type]) => {
            switch (type) {
                case "O":
                    return "";
                case "S":
                    return "private";
                default:
                    return "";
            }
        })
           .join("")
           .trim();

    let result = codeSnippet;

    if (!isEvaluation && result!== userText) {
        result = "";
    }
    return result;
}

export const generateResult = async (
    document: string,
    tokenizer: Tokenizer,
    model: SemanticTextualParser,
    knowledgeBase: KnowledgeBase,
    type: DocumentType,
) => {
    const tokenizedDoc = tokenizer.tokenizeDoc(document);
    const doc = { text: document, tokens: tokenizedDoc };
    let program = getProgram(document, model, knowledgeBase);

    if (type === DocumentType.code) {
        const newDoc = formatProgram(doc, program);
        const output = await formatCodeAndHighlight(newDoc);
        return output;
    } else {
        return program;
    }
};

export const getCodeSnippet = async (
    document: File | string,
    tokenizer: Tokenizer,
) => {
    // istantiamento
    let text = "";
    if (!document instanceof File) {
        text = document;
    } else {
        const blob = await document.blob();
        const res = await fetch(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
        const textFile = new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(await res.arrayBuffer());
        text = textFile;
    }

    const program = getProgram(text, tokenizer);

    return program;
};

<|variable|>

### How it works (detailed)

First of all, the **Template Generator** gets 3 options from the user: the number of lines, the number of classes and the number of lines per class. 

It uses a list of class names and randomly generates sentences that use **templates** defined in a dictionary. The templates can have variables or placeholders:

````
templates = {
  "line%": "%s",
  "line%+": "%s\n",
  "line%+/1": "%s%s",
  "line?%": "if %s: %s",
  "line?%+": "if %s:\n%s",
  "#line?%": "if not %s:\n%s",
  "#line?%+": "if not %s:\n%s",
  "#line#": "%s"
}
````

- *line* templates have no placeholders (example: line?)
- *line%*&*#line%* have one placeholder (example: line%?)
- *line%+*&*#line%*+ have two placeholders (example: line%+?)

Using the line templates, you can build up a random sentence by concatenating placeholders with the variables assigned to them. For example: you want to create 5 sentences, each with 3 variables (line, line and line). The templates for that are defined as follows:

}/README.md # Brainstorm Chatbot ## What is BSc? BSc is a chatbot developed with Java, which aims to train the user based on his previous answers to understand the question properly. Developed from Scratch. ## Usage: It's easy as downloading the jar file and then running the command bellow: `java -jar brainsc.jar file.txt` The file should be in the root directory, containing the text that the bot will use to train the user. ## How it works? The bot reads every line from a txt file and then splits the line after the delimiter `|
` to get the question and the answer. The bot searches for `
` to get the user input, which is saved as a list because the user may be several. Automated Test Generator (ATG)
=============================

The goal of this tool is to provide a tool to quickly get some testing with your own code, without having to be a test developer
or using an extensive test framework.

With this tool, all your code can be tested by executing the tests via an assistant directly in the browser, directly from github, with one git commit, for one line of code with your code changes, etc...

How to use

1. Fork this repo
2. Checkout in your fork
3. Create a branch for the changes you want to test
4. Generate the tests `python setup.py testgenerate`
5. Change the code as you want
6. Add changes to the git status `git status`
7. Commit your changes `git commit`
8. Push your changes to github `git push`

This will trigger a new build on the "build" job (defined in.github/workflow.yml), which runs the script.sh (See Script section below)

After merging, you can check the page `https://<username>.github.io/101-tests/builds/` and get a new link with the test page.

    if not os.path.exists(BASE_PATH):

    base_path = Path(BASE_PATH)

    if not json_files:

    tpl = jinja2.Template(template)

The remedy for this vulnerability is not necessarily the simplest, because SQL injections are quite complicated to solve: they have several stages, including several rounds of escaping. The first round of escaping removes characters that are considered unsafe. When you have done that step, you can move into a second round of escaping, where special strings are replaced by other safe strings. This second round of escaping is essential, because without it, the dangerous characters can be left in the query and SQL injections will have occurred.

    # Step 3. Replace \n with \n
    # Step 4. Replace \t with \t
    special_strings = {
        '\'': '\\\'',
        '"': '\\"',

        '\t': '\\t',

Nous voulons récupérer plusieurs enregistrements dans la base de données depuis une base de données Oracle. Nous disposons donc du nom d'une fonction SQL permettant de récupérer des enregistrements, le code source de cette fonction est donné plus haut. Ce qui nous intéresse ici est la ligne indiquant la fonction à appelée. Cette ligne ressemble encore plus à ces lignes que vous avez rencontrée auparavant.

```javascript
EXECUTE P_get_my_records(refcursor_variable);
```


Cette ligne vous amène dans l'environnement Oracle, qui l'interprète comme suit :

> "Exécute la fonction P\_get\_my\_records en la passant la variable refcursor\_variable.".> Ce qui n'en est qu'à dire, nous allons récupérer une liste de résultats qui sera stockée dans le type de données refcursor_variable. Pour ce faire il faut utiliser une fonction précise de SQL qui fait la conversion d'un type de données à un autre. C'est ce que fait cette fonction EXECUTE P\_get\_my\_records(refcursor\_variable).

À vous de jouer : Quelles sont les fonctions appelées dans la ligne EXECUTE P\_get\_my\_records(refcursor\_variable)? Vérifiez!

(et en dehors de Postgres/PostGIS, car il n'y a qu'un seul environnement pour la lecture de données!). I think it’s unbelievable how much I don’t know about blogs these days, it feels like an age of blogs and it’s crazy how long I’ve been lurking in the archives only to find myself no more. Since this is my first blog site (yes, the site itself is the blog), I thought that I would write about it so that anyone who has been wondering what they should blog about, why they should blog about it or on what they should blog about it can give me something to start thinking about. 

So, my first blog posts are now archived and I have about 360 or so blog posts from when I had an 8-year old in high school that I’m using mostly as something to remember and practice my spelling. My 2020/2021 blog posts will be coming from when my high school graduated (and after that, for 2020, or so I’m afraid). 

A lot of you have asked which tools I’ve been using to build this site, and I will be using them in my future blog posts as well (at the very least, I’ll be linking to them). I’ve also been looking into some other static site generators (SSG’s) so far. For now, I’m using GatsbyJS. I think it will be a fun time working with it. I’m also wondering if I should start using Netlify functions to be more like a serverless, progressive web application that uses JSON to create posts. 

I’ll probably have more updates as I get time to look at other tools, but for now that is the summary I’ve been able to come up with. And I’m glad I did because I’m losing my steam (which is a whole different blog) so that’s how much I need this stuff!

El algoritmo implementado recibe datos mediante una pila (push), procesa los valores en la pila desde la cima hasta el fondo (pop), y almacena los resultados en el conjunto de resultados. La entrada del usuario debe estar codificada en ASCII numérico por lo que cada vez que se almacena un valor en la pila, una nueva línea debe reemplazar el anterior valor. Para evitarlas debemos omitir la última línea de salida ya que no tendremos un 0 en nuestra salida.

## Apa itu dan tujuannya?

Sebagai back-end engineer, kita menentukan dan menyusun sebuah sistem dalam menyediakan sumber daya utama kita (input dan output) dan memelihara sistem. Kita membangun, metrik, mematuhi dan melanjutkan perencanaan sistem ini dalam dunia nyata!

## Mengenal dan Membantuan Lingkungan PHP-FPM (PHP FastCGI Process Manager)

PHP dikembangkan dan dirilis oleh Rasmus Lerdorf pada tahun 1993 dan merupakan sebuah bahasa skrip eksternal (interpretasi berbasis skrip) yang digunakan untuk membuat situs. PHP dikenal serta disukai oleh orang-orang sekitar karena, bahkan banyak sekali kontribusi telah dilakukan oleh lebih besar dari kemakmuran sang sumber daya PHP. 

Karena, PHP memiliki sebuah ekosistem yang dapat divokasi dengan kontribusi lain maupun kami, kita akan menyelesaikan tantangan masing-masing untuk memanfaatkan dukungan dan kerjasama yang terhubung untuk menanggapi permasalahan dengan benar dan efisien terhadap pengetesan kualitas kode.

## Bonus: `|` o `^`

I simboli `|` o `^` possono essere usati per ricercare le parole intere.

```java
public class Program
{
    /**
     * Cerca qualcosa nella stringa passata.
     */
    void find(String s) {... }
        
    void test() {
        find("abc|ABC|xyz|Xyz|def");          // trova "abc" e "xyz"
        find("|abc|ABC|xyz|Xyz|def|");        // trova "abc" e "xyz"
        find("^abc|ABC|xyz|Xyz|def$");        // trova "abc" e "xyz"      
        find("^abc|ABC|xyz|Xyz|$");           // trova "xyz"
        find("^abc|ABC|xyz|Xyz$|");            // trova "def"
    }
}

Avec la commande 'git log', vous pourrez visualiser tous les essais de commit (vous aurez l'impression de retrouver votre projet à chaque fois). Pour lancer un essai de commit, il suffit d'exécuter 'git add' suivi de la commande que vous voulez tester et 'git commit -m'. Il ne peut pas y avoir deux commits du même texte, ce qui pourrait créer un conflit et donner l'erreur : "'git add message' is not possible because you have unstaged changes.". Pour visualiser un essai, il suffit de taper 'git reflog'.

Pour annuler une commande, il suffit d'utiliser 'git reset HEAD~' avec un nombre différent de chiffres qui correspond à plusieurs commits. Si vous avez annulé un commit alors que vous aviez mis des fichiers à jour, vous devez utiliser 'git reset --hard HEAD~' afin de revenir à l'état avant l'annulation. La commande 'git commit --amend' lui permet d'effectuer un nouveau commit sur la même ligne, sans effacer l'ancien.

Afin de supprimer un essai, il suffit de faire ceci à partir d'un essai: 'git reset --hard HEAD~'. Pour supprimer un fichier, il n'y a pas besoin de faire une copie puis d'annuler la copie, car vous supprimez l'information pour tout le monde (avec son chemin d'origine) qu'on a laissé dans la base de données.

**Problem**

A farmer owns a square piece of land in the shape of an n × n field. 
He wishes to fence off his piece of property. He will also pay for fencing, 
per square kilometer. The problem is, he could fence off the property in n − 1 rows, 
with the last row consisting of the n squares he owns. With this arrangement, one could 
fence in n times n − 1 (or n^2 − n) square kilometers.

However, his contract specifies the following, more efficient way to fence the land in his fields. 
Given an n × n field, he will fence it off in two rows with the k − 1 squares in each row. 
The last row of squares will consist of only the one square he owns.

His question is: what is an efficient way to fence in two rows of squares? Write a program that will determine if two rows of squares are equivalent ways to fence the land.

**Input**

The input file will contain a series of lines. Each line will contain 2 × n data, the size of the squares on the field and the payment for fencing per square, terminated with a line containing only 0.

**Output**

For each test case in the input, your program should print a line containing ONLY YES (only one word) if the input describes two equivalent ways to fence the land. Otherwise, print NO.

在使用Java时，只需要将非静态方法的调用者用一个对象实例化的形式调用该方法就行了，如果这个方法不需要使用其他函数或者属性，就可以认为它是个静态方法。

## 静态方法和成员方法的区别 ##
 1. **静态方法不能直接访问非静态的函数和非静态的属性**
 2. **静态方法不能直接修改静态修饰的属性，在调用静态方法的时候，首先要实例化一个对象**
 3. **静态方法只能直接操作静态变量，而不能操作非静态变量**  
 静态方法可以同时有静态变量与静态方法：  
 一般在实现一些工具类或者一些设计模式的时候常会用到。但是静态方法不能对非静态变量进行修改、调用。  
 
 4. 静态方法只能操作静态变量和静态方法，这样才使得这个方法的复用性更高。---

@singleton
class SolutionList:
    "Kumpulan solusi"

    _solutions = cast("Dict[str, Solution]", {})

    @staticmethod
    def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Solution]:
        data = {}
        with path.open() as f:
            data = Solution.parse(f.read())
        SolutionList._solutions[path.stem] = data
        return data

    @classmethod
    def iter_all(cls) -> Iterator[tuple[str, CodeSection]]:
        for solution_name in sorted(SolutionList._solutions):
            for section in SolutionList._solutions[solution_name]:
                yield (solution_name, section)

    @classmethod
    def get_full_solution(cls, solution_name: str) -> list[str]:
        return SolutionList._solutions[solution_name].code

    @classmethod
    def get_solution_name(self, user_solution: str) -> str | None:
        user_solution = user_solution.replace('""', '""').replace('\'\'', '"').strip()
        for filename, solution in SolutionList._solutions.items():
            if user_solution == solution.text:
                return filename
        return None

    @classmethod
    def delete(cls, solution_name: str) -> None:
        del SolutionList._solutions[solution_name]

# A database
In this exercise we will make a database that will help our webshop with it's users.  
If we use a database then we can have multiple users, and it's possible to keep the data the same over sessions (and in fact it's a lot easier to do in theory). That makes it easier to add certain features to the users, or even remove users from our catalogue.

The way we make the database makes sure that we can't get any data that shouldn't be there (a user can't be able to see other people's information).

## Basic database
Before I explain how a database works, or show you a simple example, let's do a simple database with sqlite3 (but you should also try this with a mysql or postgres database).
First we will go to the folder with the flask webshop:
```sh
cd Your_Flask_Folder
```
Let's create a file for a database on the folder (You don't need to make a flask app file or anything like that, it will make a normal database):
```sh
touch database.db
```

Let's create a table called user, with the columns id and username. To be able to see this table we will make a table with this command on the terminal:
```sql
sqlite3 database.db
sqlite>.schema
```
What you see after:
```sql
CREATE TABLE user (
	id integer primary key autoincrement,
	username text unique
);
```

Now the thing we should know is how to add an entry to a table (you can run sqlite3 database.db and make it with a text editor or using the terminal).

```sql

- FLASK_ENV=Debug, pengalaman lanjutan yang diterima oleh peramban;
- FLASK_ENV=Development, pengalaman pengembangan yang diterima oleh peramban;
- FLASK_ENV = testing, pengalaman pernyataan yang diterima oleh peramban.

Dengan kebolehubah berikut, Flask akan secara eksplisit mengklarik pengalaman pernyataan yang diterima oleh peramban.

- **FLASK_ENV = Production,** mengaktifkan kode ini yang memutakhirkan program baru untuk secara terpisah dibutirkan sebagai produksi.

Flask sendiri tidak menyediakan pernyataan yang diterima, hal ini menunjukkan bahawa itu boleh dibuat dan dihapus dalam masa lampau, sementara konsepnya ada.

# app/__init__.py

    """
        Register API routes
        """

    from app.routes import test_users
    app.register_blueprint(
        blueprint=test_users.api,
        url_prefix="/test/users"
    )
```
Notice that you can register any Blueprint object. In this case, you register a single Blueprint object but in reality, you can register multiple Blueprint objects using a list or a generator.

Các hệ điều hành Java được phát triển tuỳ theo mục đích. Hệ điều hành này sẽ cố gắng xây dựng các API để cho phép các chương trình Java chạy trên nhiều cổng mạng (TCP/IP), chấp nhận nhiều hệ thống (OS) phải kết nối với nhau.

Một trong những cơ chế trong lập trình này là các API cho phép hệ điều hành giữa các bộ xứ lý hoạt động thực hiện thông qua mô phỏng việc bộ xứ lý sẽ tiến hành các giao dịch yêu cầu của người dùng (ví dụ: khi người dùng nhấn một nút bấm trên một màn hình sẽ tạo ra một gói tin yêu cầu để truyền và xử lý phản hồi theo).

Kemudian, kita bisa melakukan konfigurasi sesuai keinginan untuk proses pembuatan kunci pribadi yang akan terkait dengan basis data `MyCert`.

Sesuai dengan yang dilakukan pada [`Keytool` Sederhana](Simple Keystore Creation), pembuatan kunci `MyCert` menggunakan `keytool` seperti ini:

    keytool -genkeypair -keystore MyCert -storepass blank -keypass blank \
    -dname “cn=Administrator, ou=Admin, \
    o=MyCompany, c=ID” -keyalg RSA -alias admin

class JavaXTrustManager implements X509TrustManager {
    private String url = "javaprog.net";
    
    JavaXTrustManager(String url) {
        this.url = url;
    }
    
    public X509Certificate[] getAcceptedIssuers() {
        return new X509Certificate[0];
    }

    public void checkClientTrusted(X509Certificate[] chain, String authType) {
    }

    public void checkServerTrusted(X509Certificate[] chain, String authType) {
        if (isTrustedCertificate(chain)) {
            return;
        }

        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Can't trust this certificate: " + chain[0].getSubjectX500Principal() + 
            "\nIt will not be accepted as " + authType + " by " + url);
    }
    
    private boolean isTrustedCertificate(X509Certificate[] chain) {
        try {
            X509Certificate cert = (X509Certificate) chain[0];
            
            java.security.cert.CertificateFactory certificateFactory =
                java.security.cert.CertificateFactory.getInstance("X.509");
            java.io.InputStream inStream = new java.net.URL(this.url + "/certificate.cer").openStream();
            return certificateFactory.generateCertificate(inStream).getPublicKey().equals(cert.getPublicKey());
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

### 3. 辅助工具函数

接下来需要编写一个辅助工具函数用来生成一个 JWT 令牌。令牌的生成算法在 [JWT 官方说明](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7519#section-4.1.4)中有非常详细的说明，你也可以点击上述链接查看。

生成一个令牌需要四个部分：

- `payload` 部分就是 JWT 的有效载荷（payload）；
- `header` 部分就是 JWT 的头部信息（header）；
- `signature` 部分就是 JWT 的签名部分；
- `base64url` 处理一下三个部分的数据。

你可以使用 [JWT.io](https://jwt.io/)（可以生成令牌，也可以显示令牌的解码信息）来验证生成的令牌部分的正确性。

# CodinGame - Expert Java Challenges

![Image explanatory](images/expert_java_explanatory.png)

Challenges to get to the expert level! A mix of Java and Python challenges (more on that to come...)

## Rules

- `JAVA`: The score is the *number of correct tests*
- `PYTHON`: The score will always be 100 % (1000 tests will always pass)

The challenges are in **alphabetical order**

## Content

### [JAVA](./JAVA/)

10 expert challenges

### [PYTHON](./PYTHON/)

10 expert challenges

### [JAVA_PYTHON](./JAVA_PYTHON/)

To go from **Java** to **Python** and vice versa, there are a few easy challenges.

## Challenge Guidelines

There are 3 challenges in the format:

```JAVA
<|user|>
...
<|assistant|>
...
<|system|>
...
```

You can get a better picture of the system by clicking on **Java** or **Python** at the top of the article.

```
<|user|>
This is an example of user code
<|assistant|>
This is the assistant code
<|system|>
This is the system code
```

The challenge system is composed of an **user code** / **system code** / **assistant code**

When a user code is called, it means the user has written the code. When an assistant code is called, it means this code is provided to evaluate the user code. When the system code is called, it means that the user needs to explain how to produce his code. There is no system code for challenges dealing with the **JAVA_PYTHON** challenges.

# Introduction

Welcome to your **Java** course!

We are glad to present you the **Java** course and the associated **Assistant**.

## Goal of this course

We will introduce you to the Java ecosystem. We will explore the Java language and the tools we rely on. We will explain what the concepts you will learn will help you write better, more efficient and more readable code.

## Purpose of this training

* You will learn the Java language.
* You will be able to use your local IDE to write code, debug and deploy it.
    * You will have fun and have less stress with the command line.
* You will be able to write code that helps your colleagues.
* You will be able to write code that is readable, efficient and correct.

## Prerequisites

You should be familiar with the `git` command line and its use. Please check the repository's [README](https://github.com/french-java-dev/training#prerequisites) before starting the training.

### Descripción

La comprobación de los resultados del análisis del cifrador se basa en verificar las salidas esperadas para valores aleatorios generados aleatoriamente.
El puntaje final, se basa en verificar una cadena de caracteres codificada utilizando la función decode.

Si se cumple con el objetivo, los scores se calculan como la proporción de resultados correctos.
Cada punto que se consigue se considera como uno de los falsos positivos, ya que un elemento que este clasificado correctamente no pertenecería a la clase falsa, pero que no la ha clasificado.
Además, al utilizar solo este método, se puede considerar que:
- Si una función devuelve la clase correcta con la probabilidad de uno de los argumentos dado, la clase correcta es la que se selecciona.
- Las clases que aparecen con uno, pero para los demás que tienen 0 clasificado correctamente se considera una falsificación, y se consigue un punto con éxito.

Por ende, los resultados de la puntuación se calcularán de la siguiente manera:

```python

# Exploring Java Expert 2016

## About
Project for a coding competition for software students in Oost-Flanders (Belgium). As of September 2016, we managed to score 405 points overall out of 800 in the 100th edition. The project will be continued later when the project's theme is not disqualified from the contest. For historical reasons, this project will be labelled as EXJ2_2016.

A description of the contest itself can be found here: http://www.beeldengeluid.be/competitie/

## Structure

### Code

We are all very satisfied with our code's readability, and the project has been written with the mindset that this is an easy to read, understandable, and extensible program. The solution source files are named after the task numbers, but the code is always stored in the "src" folder (so as to not clutter the Git repo entirely).

We also plan to host all generated code on our own GitHub pages at some point (as a starting point), in a sub-repository.

## How to use the code

### Run it with your own JVM:
You can copy and paste all solutions by hand, or use the "src" file (generated by the parser) to compile your source file, and then run it. The way you can do this depends on your setup.

**On Windows:** You can use the command line to paste the file in a folder, compile it and run it.

**On Linux/Mac:** You will need to use the terminal to change the directory to the place where you copied the code, and run the command with the correct argument (the output files are located in the "src" directory).

If you cannot do this, please contact me so we can add a description how to do it.

    public void analyzeHTTPHeader(String aHeader) {
        String validChars = "[a-zA-Z0-9\\s]+";
        Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile("^[A-Z]+\\s+[^\\s]+\\s+HTTP/\\d\\.\\d$", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
        
        Matcher mHeader = pattern.matcher(aHeader.replaceAll("[\\r\\n]", ""));
        
        if (mHeader.matches()) {
            String[] splitHeader = aHeader.split(" ", 3);

            if (splitHeader[2].contains("http")) {
                String[] splitProtocol = splitHeader[2].split("/", 2);

                if (splitProtocol[0].equalsIgnoreCase("HTTP")) {
                    if (splitProtocol[1].length() == 3) {
                        String[] protocol = splitProtocol[1].split(".");

                        if (protocol[0].equals(protocol[1])) { // HTTP/x.x
                            System.out.println("HTTP protocol version " + protocol[0] + "." + protocol[1]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            System.out.println("Valid HTTP header, status code " + splitHeader[1]);
        } else {
            System.out.println("Invalid HTTP header");
        }
    }

# Otimizar a leitura de uma expressão regular

Uma expressão regular pode ser complicada durante a leitura.

Por exemplo, suponha que você queira procurar um URL na string "Vamos acessar http://www.udemy.com/javabasico.com". Você pode usar a expressão regular `/(?<=\s)http\:\/\/(?:www\.)?([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.)+(com|net|org)(?=\s|[.,;!?])/` com sucesso e obter um resultado, mas é um pouco difícil de ler:

* `\s` significa um espaço.
* `(?<=\s)` indica que o caractere que vem antes da expressão regular é um espaço.
* `http\:\/\/` é um segundo caractere que verifica a frequência do caractere.
* `(?:www\.)?` também é um segundo caractere que verifica a frequência do caractere.
* `([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.)+` é um caractere mais específico que verifica a frequência do caractere.
* `(com|net|org)` é um segundo caractere que verifica a frequência do caractere.
* `(?=\s|[.,;!?])` indica que o caractere anterior à expressão regular não seja um espaço, `;`, `,`, `?`, ou `.` (ponto).

## Code Execution

### Introduction

As we know, the function takes and executes a code snippet. The actual execution is done by the runtime, 
which in turn can interpret it. Unfortunately, due to the current Java version restriction, in most cases
the Java class files of all imported classes have to be compiled before execution. 
In a Java environment this requires to find a Java compiler. 

> In a C++ environment the concept of classes and objects would need
> a bit more. All classes and objects are loaded during runtime
> and executed.

### Consequence

The problem in our case is the **sandboxing** of all code snippets.
When the code has been sanitized out, it can only be interpreted with the interpreter of the Java runtime. 
It is also an additional complicartion to make sure that only one code snippet for a specific class can 
be executed for a limited amount of time.

### Security

Although the execution of code is very limited at this time, it should be an important security feature.
With a lot of time and resources, a code can be executed and potentially execute malicious code
which can be used to cause harm.

### Exclusions

As always you can use an exclusion list. This list contains all the imported classes of the language.

> The exclusions in the code snippet would be given as array with 
> the files as strings. But I don't want to change the code structure
> of the input for now. 
> 
> The exclusions have not to be executed!

## Additional Information

### Compilation 

The compilation process takes place right after the code has been loaded.
A compiler is the Java compiler by default but can be changed (in our case it is 
[`npe-java.js`](./assets/npe-java.js)).
The compiler is executed in an internal thread which uses the `Runtime` class.

> It would have been nice if it would have been possible to find out what happens
> to the class files of the imported objects (or the imported classes).
> But it is unfortunately not yet possible in Java. :(

In the Java world, files are often named with a.java extension (instead of.png because it allows many more characters). One of the most commonly written languages in the world, Java, uses a language called Unicode that allows characters outside the [26 characters allowed by the ASCII language](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ASCII) to be printed and used, so the file extension is.java and not.png.

The file extension is very important and is a way of indicating what exactly the file is used for.

#### `Java` files

Java files are the most important files used in the Java environment. They usually have an extension of.java so that the computer can quickly check the extension of the file and make the correct action to the file.

Most Java code is executed inside a method. When code is executed for the first time in a method, that means that the Java interpreter will execute that code, just like a normal code execution.

Inside the code, variables are defined and used. Variables can be integer (whole numbers such as 1 and 85285204352), doubles (numbers with a decimal point, such as 3.14) or characters which are letters. They are defined in a specific way and start with the keyword `int` for example.

For a variable to be used for something, it has to be initialized with a default value inside the initialization code. If no further code is written to the variable, that means the value stored is 0 (zero). The default character would be the space character'' (only in an empty variable).

# Java-Exercise-Package

## Requirements

* Java version 11
* Eclipse AdoptOpenJDK 11

## Installation

Clone the repository and import the project into Eclipse
```bash
git clone https://github.com/jereksel/Java-Exercise-Package.git
```

Run the application
```bash
./run.sh
```

## Usage

Start the program in Eclipse and select the files you wish to run.
The app will take the folder name and ask for your Java environment.
It will create and fill that folder with the files required for the exercises.

There are 10 different files in each exercise, numbered from 1-10.
Running the exercise will run each of the 10 challenges.
The app will ask if you want to run it again and if you want to run in single file mod or multifile mode.
In single file mode, only one file is executed at a time.

## Passo 8

A gente ficou com uma "nossa" linguagem que se baseia de uma rejeição de entrada nos níveis básicos (sem tipo ou coerção do que seria uma operação válida) e a de 14 níveis de rejeição para uma conversão.

Enfim, temos uma máquina capaz de analisar e de reconhecer expressões de entrada, mas a aplicação é interativa, com um sistema operacional, e queremos ter uma máquina que rodar com um programa "padrao" sem ser muito código, se possível.

Para isso fizemos uma máquina em Pearl que se comunicava com a mesma entrada e saída.
Alguns passos intermediários ficaram em Scala.

A máquina Pearl é realmente um [lenguaje simples](/about) e funciona com strings e tipos primitivos. Não há nada "interno" para um tipo de dados como um array.

```
if not (s == null | "" |'')
  print(s)

If you have **no** special characters like `>`, `]`, `0` you can count every character which is coming from the **input** by **subtraction** `input.length() - text.length()`.

If you have any other special case like `>` we subtract this case by `1` because there is only one different `>` but there is lot of character coming from input so there is possibility that this `>` also come from `input` so we subtract by `1` from 0 to make sure at least there are some char and then subtract from `input.length()` as I mentioned above.

# Aim
In Java, a serialiser can be used, to store objects in binary (serialised) form, 
without the need to provide the original code/class structure. (this is known as an "Object Stream"). 
The serialiser is provided by the `ObjectOutputStream` class, 
and the deserialiser by the `ObjectInputStream` class. 

The code provided can be used to demonstrate:
  * serializing and deserializing objects (e.g. the result of some calculation).
  * using a customised deserialiser (e.g. deserialise without throwing an exception)

# What you will learn
In this exercise you will:
  * Create a serialised object and store it in a bytes array.
  * Deserialize the serialised object and use it.

# Hints
* Create an object `ObjectOutputStream` and write an instance of the `Users` class to a `ByteArrayOutputStream`.
* Create an object `ObjectOutputStream` and write an instance of the `Users` class to a `ByteArrayOutputStream`, 
and then use it as a source to construct an object `ObjectInputStream` to read the data from.
* In the first deserialisation try to use the `Users` `static readObject` method.

to help get the right structure for the object that you will build.
* In the first attempt to do the deserialisation, change the return type to `Users`, so that a `NullPointerException` is thrown when attempting to use
the default deserialisation mechanism. 
* The deserialisation should be tried and caught when recreating the object and it should be used. (`static {…}`)

	 * Constructeur static
	 *

	 */
	public static Configuration build(final String configurationString) {
		final Configuration toReturn = new ConfigurationImpl();
		parse(toReturn, configurationString);
		return toReturn;
	}
	private static void parse(final Configuration configuration, final String yamlString) {
		try {
			if (isEmpty(yamlString)) {
				return;
			}
			
			final ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper(new YAMLFactory());
			final Object obj = mapper.readValue(yamlString, Object.class);
			
			configuration.set(obj);
		} catch (final Exception ex) {
			throw new ConfigException(ex.getMessage(), ex);
		}
	}

			throw new ConfigException("Must be null");
		}
	}
	private static boolean isEmpty(final String ymlString) {
		return ymlString == null || (ymlString!= null && ymlString.trim().length() == 0);
	}
}

You now know at least the basic of **OOP** programming and of **multithreading**, so it is time to apply what you already know into a larger application. In this module we will dive deeper into Java, this time on building applications and testing.

## The course

The course is made up of four parts, each consisting of multiple sections.

### Building

This section will contain projects that allow you to practice on more complex use cases. You can use them to understand advanced Java features that will be used in the future. Some projects have already been done for you and will be shared in this repository, and you can also complete the assignments from the exercises in this repository. 

* If you have done the `java-oop` project already, or you want to implement the assignments yourself, you can move to the following modules. If you don't have the `java-oop` project already, and still wish to check out the exercises, [you can create one here](./creating-a-project-with-intellij-and-git)!

### Testing

This section will contain a number of different projects that are already built for you and that have already been tested and passed through the course. These are projects that represent complex scenarios of Java and its functionality. The projects created here will help you better understand how the software development process works. 

In this section you can also build your own projects, but this is not required.

### Refactoring

This section will contain exercises to help you better understand more advanced Java functionality. The exercises in this section are based on smaller projects from the first two parts. 

In these projects small parts have been replaced, and each part needs to be replaced by the right code. To help you, there is a solution that you can compare with your own, and if you want you can also read a certain part of the implementation of the correct code.

In this section you can also build your own projects, in fact this is encouraged!

#### Bingung dengan `Base64`?
Base64 diofusikan karena nama variabel yang dibuat kosong, sehingga tidak terlihat dari luar untuk mengacu ke API eksternal. Namun, dengan kedua kunci tersebut, kunci rahasia dan simulasi kunci, maka kedua kunci berbeda. Maka jika kamu menjalankan program ini, kunci rahasia dan simulasi kunci akan berbeda. Sementara itu, jika kamu buat ulang program ini untuk memberikan solusi (bukankah `Base64` mudah untuk diofuskai?) maka kedua nama variabel akan mengacu ke API eksternal.

# that divides given number `n` into `d` equal parts.
#
# @param n number to divide
# @param d number of equal parts
# @return smallest `x`, that divides `n` into `d` equal parts
def solution(n, d) -> int:
    assert n >= d > 0

    # The main idea of solution is: for 1<x<n, there may be a possible solution,
    # x > x_old, but (x+1) %d!= 0, hence (x+1) - (x_old + 1) >= d
    # Which means (x+1) / (x_old + 1) > 1 - d/n, hence
    # (x+1) / (x_old + 1) > d/n - 1
    x_max = pow(2, 32) * d - d + 1
    x = x_max

    # Binary search
    while n % x!= 0:
        x_old = x
        x >>= 1

        if x_old >= x and n % x!= 0:
            print(f"No solution")
            sys.exit(0)
    return x or 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    n, d = list(map(int, input().split()))

    print(solution(n, d))

	if (n == 0) {

    String fetchAndDecode(String url) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(new URL(url).openStream()));
        String line;
        StringBuilder input = new StringBuilder();
        while ((line = r.readLine())!= null){
            input.append(line);
        }
        r.close();
        byte[] bContent = input.toString().getBytes();
        return new String(bContent, "utf8");
    }
